cc:Work.dc:title: Fe2S2 resource tradeoffs, compact panel (a)
cc:Work.dc:description: Pinned 41,052-term alias--SELECT--unlookup; 40 system qubits, 16 row bits, 16 coin bits. Original alias precision, signs and normalization. Initial uniform preparation, reflection, QPE and additional external control excluded. Native Toffoli count versus peak total logical qubits. Frozen rows retain their original full/subset scope. Every new row has 82,104 all-row comparator-boundary checks and up to 65,536 unchanged upstream native probes. Full 18,419,296-shot schedules were not rerun for the new rows. No global optimality claim.
